title: CompactedTombstones
description: Decayed milestones for features older than current major - 1. Compacted into single-line tombstones to prevent historical document bloat.

react-native.pre_0.76_paper_bridge: React Native Bridge (Paper), NativeModulesEventEmitter, and ViewPropTypes permanently removed in 0.82; New Architecture default since 0.76.

react-native-reanimated.pre_v3_reanimated_v1_nodes: Reanimated v1 nodes (Animated.Value, cond, set, block, call) fully removed; v2/v3 shared values and worklets are the sole foundation.

react-native-gesture-handler.pre_v2_legacy_wrappers: Legacy component handlers (<PanGestureHandler>, <TapGestureHandler>) permanently obsolete; replaced by GestureDetector and v3 hooks.

react-native-mmkv.pre_v4_legacy_bridge: MMKV v1/v2/v3 synchronous JSI classes (new MMKV()) replaced by Nitro Modules factory (createMMKV()).
